descriptionPlain:
At Gopuff, we are not just delivering convenience. We are redefining how the world shops. Since pioneering instant needs in 2013, we have empowered millions across the U.S. and U.K. to take back their time through fast, seamless, and reliable delivery. This transformation is driven by our tech-first mindset and an obsession with operational excellence.
To continue shaping the future of commerce, we are looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Supply Chain & In-stock to join our mission. We win through collaboration, not competition, fostering a culture where curiosity and respect lead to shared success. Here, data is a tool for empowerment, not gatekeeping, and there is no room for arrogance. We are simply committed to helping one another make an impact.
If you are a high performer who thrives in fast-paced environments, this is an opportunity to innovate and leave a lasting mark on one of the world's most disruptive industries. Ready to shape what's next? Let's go. 🚀

lists.content:
• Own the delivery of core metrics including availability, waste, and inventory days.
  • Manage and develop the team through clear goal setting and regular performance management.
  • Execute end-to-end seasonal planning to ensure inventory readiness for peak trading periods.
  • Partner with suppliers to improve lead times, service levels, and overall cost efficiencies.
  • Lead cross-functional projects to automate workflows and resolve systemic supply chain blockers.

• Over 6 years of professional experience in supply chain, inventory management, or retail.
  • Significant experience in people management and building high-performing operational teams.
  • Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in SQL and building data-driven frameworks.
  • Strong commercial negotiation skills and experience managing large-scale supplier relationships.
  • Ability to manage complex projects and influence stakeholders across the wider business.
  • Proven experience in driving innovation with the use of new tools and technlogy.

• We want to help our employees stay safe and healthy. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision and mental health support to all eligible employees. 
  • Company RSUs (Restricted Stock Units)
  • Gopuff employee rewards
  • Annual performance appraisal and bonus
